channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Willy Hernangomez | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Willy Hernangomez from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Willy Hernangomez
item.description:
“I say it a lot, and I don’t just see it because they are my teammates, I say it because I mean it. This is a special team. People forget that Willy (Hernangomez) won MVP in the Euro League. That is not an easy accomplishment because the rules are harder over there than in the NBA. “Me and Willy (Hernangomez) talk all the time and I tell him how I wish he could play more. He understands the name of the game and that we have a deep team. Whenever his number is called, he always steps up.”

Zion Williamson on Willy Hernangomez, Dec 6, 2022. Source: The Bird Writes.

item.title: Devonte Graham on Willy Hernangomez
item.description:
Eliot Clough:Devonte Graham on being teammates again with Billy Hernangomez:

“That's my guy. I played with him in Charlotte. He's high energy. He's the first person I hit up when I saw I was coming.”

Devonte Graham on Willy Hernangomez, Aug 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @EliotClough.

item.title: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Willy Hernangomez
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Nickeil Alexander-Walker on the personality of Willy Hernangomez (13 pts, 11 reb vs. Sac):

“He's a great guy, one of the best teammates I've had. He's a real brother who looks out for his teammates... if there is someone in this world who doesn't like him, I'm surprised.”

Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Willy Hernangomez, Feb 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Willy Hernangomez
item.description:
Antonio Martin:Kristaps Porzingis:

“I tell (Hernangomez) to keep working and not to show he's frustrated. He's obviously frustrated and that's normal.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Willy Hernangomez, Jan 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @MartinGuirado.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Willy Hernangomez
item.description:
There is speculation that Hornacek could look to Hernangomez ahead of veteran Kyle O’Quinn.

“I think [Hernangomez] probably is [in the running for sixth man] for some of the things that he’s been doing for us,”

Jeff Hornacek on Willy Hernangomez, Oct 16, 2016. Source: Newsday.
